text:
julia: Quick follow-up from the authz postmortem — thanks for the investigations. We need firm owners and short windows to close remediation items this sprint.
julia: Summary: two failure modes: (1) service-token rotation job missed runs after a permissions change, (2) audit-collector dropped events during a pipeline retry flood. Both combined hid symptoms until clients started failing token validation.
julia: Remediation buckets: rotation reliability, audit coverage + backfill, CI/regression, and monitoring/SLOs.
julia: Proposed concrete actions (owner -> due):
- omar -> rotation-run watchdog + alert (due 2026-04-04)
- trent -> audit backfill script + validation query (due 2026-04-03)
- security-eng -> consolidated runbook + SLO targets (due 2026-04-02)
- omar+trent -> add nightly synthetic that exercises rotation -> audit path (due 2026-04-06)

omar: I'll take the watchdog. Plan: small service that checks last-success timestamp and emits metric. PR tomorrow morning.
omar: sample check I'll wire in:
```
# pseudo
last = read_db('rotation_last_success')
if now - last > timedelta(minutes=20):
  emit_metric('rotation_missed')
```

trent: I'll handle the backfill and validation. Will create an idempotent backfill that uses event IDs and a validation query to confirm completeness. Need security-eng to sign off on fields.

security-eng: We'll write the runbook and propose SLOs. Early suggestion: token-validation success >= 99.95% over 7d, page if < 99.9% sustained for 30m. We'll include escalation steps and owner rotation in the runbook.

ops-bot: Reminder: remediation standup scheduled Fri 09:00 PT. Auto-reminder will post 2h before.

julia: Please add tracker tickets and link PRs/issues here. Owners, when you close your item post a one-line status update in this thread so we can mark the postmortem remediated.

omar: PR created: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1055 — watchdog + Prom rule. PTAL.

trent: Backfill issue: https://redwood-internal/issue/4812 — includes ES query, idempotency notes, and staging run plan. I'll run in staging first, then request approval.

security-eng: Runbook draft here: https://docs.redwood/internal/runbooks/authz-token-followup.md — adding SLO rationale and alerting thresholds today.

julia: Pattern note: we've seen rotation-related incidents 3x over the past year. After these items, let's add monthly smoke tests and surface token-health on the ops dashboard.

omar: Will add the synthetic nightly job that does a rotation and asserts audit ingestion; results will feed a token-health metric.

trent: Adding a CI regression that mocks clock skew to catch TTL edge cases — will aim for non-flaky nightly run.

julia: Thanks team. If anything blocks, flag early in this thread and ping me. Once items are closed, post the one-line update so we can close the postmortem tracker. :white_check_mark:
